nodes.title: After director22 (no topic passes; 13 contradictions, 10 of them one picture regression): what she reads and where she joins are decided once and counted. P pictures always draw (done); G4 a counts table diffed at every integration; R the reader measured by readerAgrees against the rule-based child's intent, and decided by what she last asked; T the ending (answer board from the key's first character, lead-in, wrap its own turn with one checked model sentence about the child); J2 one seam pass places every joint; H, B, W, K, A; Learning re-read (clause 8). Reverse-if per item in docs/design/round7/judgements/director22-2026-11-15.md

director22: 16 lessons on integration 57 (3ef74ffdd), 1,721 calls, about $1.23; four Opus judges by hand. Contradictions 5, 5, 2, 1 (c4, c5-t01, c5-t02, c6) and unsaid boards 0, 0, 2, 0; 0 misgrades in 274 verdicts; listening 3, 3, 3, 3.5; register 3 in all four; promises 3.5, 4, 3.5, 3.5. Live predicate check read orderParts 2 and 0 elsewhere. Picture requests that drew a view: 6 of 16 (director21: 16 of 16)

The later-keys caption rule (Studio bba2a2add, merged by main in integration 54, live in release 27) withheld a picture's whole view when neither caption was clean: 10 of 12 picture requests in the three fraction pilots drew nothing and she said a picture could not be made. Fixed in integration 58: the view is always drawn, with a line that names nothing

The free dry run before director22 showed all 10 picture rows with no view; 41 predicates read 0 over them because none counted views. A paid run and four judges found what one count would have. Gated predicate pictureDrawn added (10 on director22's rows, 0 on the fix)

Authored seam joints added by each code path of the walk (dc-r8-director21 J1): in director22 backTo was said about 15 times with nothing to return to and was missing on about 20 real returns; joints were stacked, doubled, and put between a point and its own card; one form in every lesson. Replaced by one seam pass over the assembled turn (J2)

director22 clause 4 (register below 3.5 in two topics: the model writes the joins) met its number in 4 of 4 topics; three of four judges, asked for the cause by the clause itself, said placement by the walk and that a model join would not fix it. Main did not apply the remedy and recorded the departure; J2's reverse-if applies it without deferral if register stays low with joints placed right

G4: the dry matrix prints a table of counts of what a child sees and hears (views per picture request, joints per seam, reader agreement, boards changed, cards re-said); every integration diffs it against the last, and a count that moves without being named in the merge stops the integration. Reverse if it stops two integrations running for named, intended changes: cut the table to counts that have caught a fault
